# Parley v0.1.24

This test beta makes agent drafts easier to identify and review, and preserves
the original evidence returned through a delegation when the delivery pack is
edited.

## Context menu and review

- Waiting approvals appear first, separately from saved agent drafts. Draft
  labels show the pack or returned-file name, source, requested target when
  present, and relative age. Labels refresh when the menu opens.
- The menu shows the newest eight saved drafts; older drafts open Status
  Center's Live section. Accessibility descriptions distinguish waiting
  approvals from saved drafts.
- Discard one editable draft or use Discard All Editable Drafts with
  confirmation. A discard refuses a draft that changed or became a waiting
  Ask while the confirmation was open; it cannot decline that Ask.
- Requested command runs show every waiting or running request before the
  bounded list of finished runs, so older active requests remain visible.

## Provenance and returned files

- An agent-proposed Context Pack no longer claims its material was selected
  by the person before approval. Approval is stated separately from source
  provenance, and sources captured by the person keep their own provenance.
- Older agent reviews retain an honest origin. When an old failed or
  interrupted record cannot establish whether delivery was approved, the
  header says approval was not recorded.
- Files returned with `parley done --file` retain an exact copy of the staged
  part, separate from edits or removals made before delivery. After the draft
  is resolved or discarded, Show returned file on the completed handoff lets
  the person read that original without sending it anywhere, while the core
  retains the resolved review (newest 100 records).
- Older returned-file records show only remaining agent-provided parts and
  explain that they may have been edited. Separately captured files are never
  presented as the original agent return.

Agent protocol remains at version 28.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
